_note: Tags let a machine appear in every category it belongs to without splitting product URLs. A single winding machine that serves both brushed and brushless motors carries both tags and shows up on both listing pages, and the product page itself keeps one canonical URL.
_taxonomy: Two axes: motor type (what it makes) and process stage (what it does). A third axis, 'form', separates a standalone machine from an integrated production line. Every product carries one or more tags on each axis it belongs to.

winding.label: Winding
winding.description: Wire placement onto stators, armatures or coils.

bldc-winding.label: BLDC / brushless winding
bldc-winding.description: Winding equipment for brushless motor stators - in-slot, out-slot, and hairpin routes.

brushed-winding.label: Brushed / universal winding
brushed-winding.description: Winding equipment for brushed and universal motor armatures - hook-type, stuff-type and two-pole stator.

coil-winding.label: Coil winding
coil-winding.description: Air-core and multi-axis bobbin winding, independent of motor type.

slot-insulation.label: Slot liner insertion
slot-insulation.description: Automatic feeding, cutting, forming and insertion of slot insulation paper.

wedge-insertion.label: Slot wedge insertion
wedge-insertion.description: Driving closing wedges into stator or armature slots after winding.

fusing.label: Fusing / welding
fusing.description: Resistive hot-staking of enamelled winding wire onto commutator tangs or stator terminals.

commutator.label: Commutator
commutator.description: Commutator slot cutting, pressing and machining.

turning.label: Turning
turning.description: Precision turning of commutator OD, armature OD, and shaft ends.

balancing.label: Dynamic balancing
balancing.description: Rotor balancing and correction, dynamic and static.

varnish.label: Varnish and bake
varnish.description: Impregnation and bake of wound stators and armatures.

testing.label: Testing
testing.description: Electrical and mechanical inspection of finished stators, armatures and rotors.

assembly.label: Assembly
assembly.description: Rotor, commutator, shaft, impeller press-fit and cell-based assembly.

feeding.label: Automated feeding
feeding.description: Vibratory bowl, turntable and transfer feeding systems.

brushed-motor.label: Brushed motor
brushed-motor.description: Equipment for brushed DC and universal motor production.

brushless-motor.label: Brushless (BLDC) motor
brushless-motor.description: Equipment for BLDC and hairpin motor production.

cooling-fan-motor.label: Cooling-fan motor
cooling-fan-motor.description: Equipment for shaded-pole, PSC and BLDC cooling-fan motor production.

drone-motor.label: Drone / micro BLDC
drone-motor.description: Small-diameter, high-precision BLDC lines for drone and micro-motor applications.

armature.label: Armature
armature.description: Wound armatures used in brushed and universal motors.

stator.label: Stator
stator.description: Stators for brushed, brushless and universal motors.

semiconductor.label: Semiconductor
semiconductor.description: Sealing and testing process equipment for semiconductor packaging.

standalone.label: Standalone machine
standalone.description: Machines specified and supplied on their own.

production-line.label: Production line
production-line.description: Integrated modular or purpose-built production lines.

robotics.label: Robotic integration
robotics.description: SCARA and six-axis robotic cells for handling and inter-station transfer.

custom.label: Custom automation
custom.description: Purpose-built automation where a catalogue machine does not fit.

_productTagsNote: One entry per product slug. Order within each list does not matter. Every product carries at least one process tag and at least one form tag; motor-type and component tags apply where the machine is dedicated to a particular motor or workpiece.
